questions.q: Why does this lesson avoid stating specific ServiceNow salary figures?
options: ServiceNow salaries are a closely guarded secret with no public information at all
Compensation varies enormously by region, company, industry, and experience, and a stated figure would mislead many readers and go stale quickly
All ServiceNow roles pay exactly the same regardless of region or level
Salary is not something candidates should ever discuss
questions.explain: The lesson teaches the research method instead of a number, because any single figure would be misleading for a meaningful share of readers.

questions.q: What does this lesson recommend for researching your market range?
options: Guessing based on general cost-of-living intuition alone
Asking only the hiring company and accepting their first number as the market rate
Triangulating across several sourced references — survey sites, comparable postings, professional communities — rather than trusting one number
Trusting the first salary figure you find online without cross-checking it
questions.explain: Triangulating across multiple sources gets closer to reality than any single self-reported data source.

questions.q: When should you decide your walk-away point, according to this lesson?
options: During the negotiation call itself, based on how the conversation feels in the moment
Only after accepting the job, as a formality
A walk-away point is unnecessary and should never be set
In advance, privately, before stress or excitement about an offer can distort the decision
questions.explain: Deciding in advance, with a clear head, keeps the conversation calm regardless of how the offer conversation goes.

questions.q: What does this lesson mean by negotiating "the whole offer"?
options: Refusing to discuss anything except a signing bonus
Negotiating is limited strictly to vacation days
Focusing exclusively on the base salary number and ignoring everything else
Considering bonus structure and real historical payout, benefits, time off, flexibility, and start date — not just base salary
questions.explain: Base salary is one piece of a larger package, and a company with limited room on base often has more room elsewhere.

questions.q: What does this lesson say happens to the tradeoff-defense skill from Lesson 24 over time?
options: It becomes irrelevant once you accept your first ServiceNow job offer
It has no connection to real project experience at all
It only applies during the technical screening stage and nowhere else afterward
It compounds with real project experience, the same way Lesson 7 described the realistic path toward Technical Architect
questions.explain: Each real engagement after this course gives you another decision to be able to explain clearly next time, building toward real CTA-level readiness.
